title: Pollock with butter beans and radishes

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or a plain staple; vegetable stock and tinned butter beans are explicitly allowed.

supermarket.reason: Pollock fillets, butter beans, leeks, radishes and crème fraîche are all everyday Tesco items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs one wide lidded pan and simple softening, simmering and steaming that a beginner can manage.

works.reason: Two tins of beans, 300ml stock and four fillets steamed for 8 to 10 minutes give a properly cooked, well-sauced dish for four.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes covers slicing leeks, garlic and radishes and snipping chives, and 8+5+10 minutes plus wilting matches the 25 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm April bean pot with 300g of radishes, used both cooked and raw, makes the radishes central rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fish, beans and greens make a filling, balanced lunch a family would happily eat again.
